test_title: PYST 38: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Tarun starts from Point Y and drives 36 km towards west. He then takes a left turn, drives 83 km, turns right and drives 68 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 55 km. He takes a right turn, drives 41 km. He then turns left, drives 28 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Tarun starts from Point Y and drives 36 km towards west. He then takes a left turn, drives 83 km, turns right and drives 68 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 55 km. He takes a right turn, drives 41 km. He then turns left, drives 28 km to stop at Point Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abeee42a6132667ce34bbba801d5724f390ee72dc290960a3950ba7c66a247f9.png] 

Thus, he should drive 63 km towards east in order to reach Point Y again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
